# Botmintx Brand Guide

> Near-black, one mint accent, and a small cast of characters. The Botmintx mascot is a
> recognizable **homage** to the Grok Bot construction (a flat shape with two capsule eyes) with
> our own touches. It is never a copy of official art, and it never uses xAI or X logos.
> **Unofficial community project. Not affiliated with xAI or X Corp.**

---

## 1. Names

| Name | What it is | Write it as |
|---|---|---|
| **Botmintx** | The org, brand, and community | Capital *B*, one word |
| **botmint** | The engine, CLI, and npm package | Lowercase; in `code` when it's a command |
| **Genesis** | The fixed launch drop of 10,000 bots | Capitalized |
| **#0001–#10000** | Bot numbers | `#` plus four zero-padded digits (#10000 is the one five-digit number) |

- The wordmark reads **botmintx**, all lowercase, in a single color.
- Repos: `github.com/botmintx` (org), `botmintx/botmint` (main repo).
- Creator: Brandon M. Crenshaw (GitHub [@brandononchain](https://github.com/brandononchain), X [@brandononchain](https://x.com/brandononchain)).

## 2. Principles

1. **One accent.** Mint is the only brand color. Everything else is black, white, or gray.
2. **Characters do the decorating.** No gradients, glows, dot grids, helixes, or particle fields in the layout. If a layout feels empty, make the type bigger or add a bot, not an effect.
3. **Flat mark, dimensional characters.** The logo mark, wordmark, and favicon are flat: fills only, no strokes, shadows, or bevels. The Genesis PFPs are the one place with 3D shading (see section 7). They still have no outlines and no mouth.
4. **Big confident type, generous space.** One headline, one supporting line, then stop.
5. **Honest.** Never claim stats, users, or features that don't exist. Say *planned* when something is planned.

## 4. Typography

| Role | Typeface | Settings |
|---|---|---|
| Wordmark | **Geist SemiBold (600)** | Lowercase, tracking −3.2%, converted to paths |
| Headlines | **Geist Medium (500)** | Tracking −1.5 to −3% at display sizes |
| Body | **Geist Regular (400)** | Default tracking |
| Code, DNA, labels | **Geist Mono (400/500)** | Small caps-style labels get +8% tracking |

Geist and Geist Mono are free under the SIL Open Font License. All brand SVGs convert text to paths, so nothing depends on installed fonts.

## 5. The mascot

### What we learned from the Grok Bot construction

Grok Bot faces, as shown publicly on the Grok Bot design pages, follow a short set of rules:

- **One flat, solid shape** in a single ink color. No outline, no shading.
- **Two vertical capsule eyes**, cut out in the background color. No pupils, no mouth, no nose.
- **Expression lives in the eyes**: size, spacing, squash, lids, and small tilts that suggest the head turning.
- **Variety comes from the silhouette** (blob, pebble, squircle, dome, drop, cloud, and so on) and the color, not from added detail.

### Our touch

| Botmintx element | Why |
|---|---|
| **Mint sprout** on the head of the mark | Botmint "grows" bots from seeds. It also makes the silhouette ours. |
| **Squircle head, upright eyes, centered** | Deliberately different from the official logo (a circle with tilted eyes off to one side). |
| **Mint palette** with spearmint, fern, and an epic obsidian (black body, mint eyes) | One signature color family. |
| **The sprout grows through every hat** (up through the Cap's button, the Beanie, the Bucket Hat, and the Crown) and a Seed Pendant | Small details that belong only to Botmintx. |

### Homage, not counterfeit

- ✅ Use the shared construction: flat shape plus capsule eyes.
- ❌ Don't trace, copy, or recolor official Grok Bot artwork, the Grok Bot logo, or any xAI or X logo.
- ❌ Don't place Botmintx art next to official marks in a way that implies endorsement.
- ✅ Keep the disclaimer near the brand: *Unofficial community project. Not affiliated with xAI or X Corp.*

## 6. Logo

| Asset | File |
|---|---|
| Mark (mint, transparent) | `assets/logo-mark.svg` |
| Lockup, dark | `assets/logo-wordmark-dark.svg` (fog type, mint mark) |
| Lockup, light | `assets/logo-wordmark-light.svg` (ink type, mint-deep mark) |
| Favicon / app tile | `assets/favicon.svg` (graphite tile, bolder sprout for small sizes) |

**Construction.** A 128-unit grid. Head: superellipse (n = 4) 100 × 92 units, centered at (64, 80). Eyes: two capsules 12.5 × 32, centered 26 units apart, cut out as holes so the background shows through. Sprout: a 5-unit stem growing from the head with two lens-shaped leaves, the right one larger.

**Rules.**
- The mark is always one color: mint on dark, mint-deep or ink on light.
- In the lockup, the mark is 1.22× the wordmark size, sits on the baseline, and is separated from the type by 0.22× the type size.
- Clear space is the height of the sprout on every side.
- Minimum size: 16 px for the favicon version, 24 px for the standard mark.
- Don't add gradients, outlines, shadows, or a mouth. Don't tilt the eyes in the logo; posed eyes belong to the PFPs.

## 7. Genesis PFPs (v6.2, final)

<p align="center"><img src="assets/pfp-grid.png" width="720" alt="Genesis preview PFPs, v6.2"></p>

Each Genesis bot has a collectible PFP. It's the mascot, dressed up.

- **Head:** a mint squircle (superellipse n = 4) with two cut-out capsule eyes and the two-leaf sprout.
- **Never:** outlines or a mouth.
- **Shading:** soft 3D, with one light from the upper left. The head has a gloss highlight, a rim light, and soft contact shadows. Every hat, frame, and garment uses the same light.

**Layers** (7): Background (8), Body (11), Eyes (7), Headwear (7), Eyewear (6), Clothing (7), Accessory (5).

| Layer | Options |
|---|---|
| Background | Mint Wash, Carbon, Paper, Lilac, Sky, Butter, Coral, Sage |
| Body | Mint, Spearmint, Deep Mint, Fog, Graphite, Lilac, Cobalt, Sky, Gold, Obsidian, Glitch |
| Eyes | Idle, Joy, Wink, Wide, Sleepy, Glance, Focus |
| Headwear | None, Cap, Beanie, Bucket Hat, Crown, Headphones, Headband |
| Eyewear | None, Specs, Shades, Visor, VR Goggles, Monocle |
| Clothing | Bare, Tee, Hoodie, Bomber, Turtleneck, Puffer, Blazer |
| Accessory | None, Chain, Seed Pendant, Scarf, Lanyard |

**Rules.**
- Turtleneck + Scarf is invalid.
- VR Goggles hide the eyes, so Eyes counts once under VR Goggles.
- That leaves **753,984 distinct valid combinations** plus **3 hand-made 1/1s**: Full Bloom, Spacewalk, and Blueprint.

**Tiers.** The first match wins.

| Tier | Rule | Combinations |
|---|---|---|
| 1/1 | Hand-made, not rolled | 3 |
| Legendary | Gold, Obsidian, or Glitch body | 205,632 |
| Rare | Crown, VR Goggles, or Monocle | 182,784 |
| Uncommon | 2+ of Headphones, Bucket Hat, Visor, Shades, Bomber, Puffer, Blazer, Chain, Seed Pendant | 206,080 |
| Common | Everything else | 159,488 |

Mint weights, and therefore per-trait odds, are _planned_ and not set.

**The Cap.** A clear baseball cap. It has:
- a domed six-panel crown with seams, eyelets, and a top button
- a long, curved, stitched brim that projects toward the viewer, seen slightly from above
- a brim shadow that falls on the face but stays clear of the eyes

The sprout comes up through the button. Review sheet: `packages/avatars/previews/pfp-cap.png`, with 128 px checks.

**Source.** The trait art, rules, tier definitions, golden SVG renders, and previews are in `packages/avatars/`. That's a Python reference generator, with a TypeScript port into the engine _planned_.

### PFP guardrails

- No outlines and no mouth. Expression lives in the eyes.
- Keep the mint squircle head and the two-leaf sprout on every regular PFP. Hats must let the sprout through.
- Headwear and eyewear must never cover the eyes unless they're meant to hide them (Shades, Visor, VR Goggles).
- PFP colors belong to the characters. Don't use them for UI.
- Original geometry only. Never trace or recolor official Grok Bot art.

## 8. Layout

- **Banners (1280 × 400):** the approved lockup at left, one headline, one supporting line, and a 3 × 2 cluster of v6.2 PFPs on the right. The disclaimer goes small at the bottom left. Files: `banner-dark.svg/png`, `banner-light.svg/png`.
- **Social preview (1280 × 640):** centered lockup, headline, supporting line, a row of seven v6.2 PFPs, and the disclaimer. Files: `social-preview.svg/png`.
- **PFP card (480 × 840):** the PFP, the number, its tier, and the seven trait rows. No odds are shown until mint weights are set (_planned_). File: `pfp-card-0001.svg/png`.
- Corner radius: about 14% of the tile on PFP tiles in banners (18 px at 132 px), 16 px on the card's art, and 28 px on cards. The PFP brings its own background, so don't add another tile color behind it.

## 9. Voice

Plain, specific, and a little warm. Short sentences. Say what something does, not how revolutionary it is. Mark anything unbuilt as *planned*. No hype words, emoji headings, or invented numbers.
